title: Transitions lab (source of the Transitions pack)
summary: The 11 comps the Transitions pack was built and verified in: 7 cover transitions with stand-in scenes and 4 reveal recipes (shape reveal, line sweep, whip pan, zoom blur punch).
use_when: You want to see a transition working with two scenes before using it, or copy a reveal recipe's keys onto your own scenes.
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Stand-in scenes are 'Scene A' / 'Scene B'; templates are extracted with --drop for both.
Masks: the window or star is the mask; mask.make takes the FIRST id as the mask.
Every comp lints 0/0; qc at 240 px finds no flashes.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
